features.title: Learner Profiles
features.description: Learner Profiles store information about each student including name, grade level, learning preferences, review settings, timers, and learner-specific controls. Learner management now lives inside the facilitator Syllabus as the Learners overlay.
features.howToUse: On the facilitator Syllabus, click Learners. Click a learner to activate that learner. Use the gear button beside a learner to open one settings overlay with tabs for Basic, Questions per Phase, AI Features, Timers, and Review Settings. Use Add learner from the overlay to create another profile.

features.title: Learner Selection
features.description: The Learners overlay on the facilitator Syllabus is the facilitator-side learner selector. Clicking a learner activates that learner and updates the Syllabus to that learner while preserving separate learner records.
features.howToUse: Click Learners beside Plan details on the Syllabus. In the overlay, click a learner card to activate that learner. Use the gear button for settings instead of activating.

features.title: Learner Transcript
features.description: The Learner Transcript is a detailed record of all lessons completed with Ms. Sonoma, including what was taught, how the learner responded, and their comprehension progress. It helps you track learning over time and see patterns in understanding.
features.howToUse: Open a learner's gear settings from the Learners overlay and use View Transcripts when you need the detailed learner record. Ms. Sonoma can also use supported learner evidence when helping the facilitator.

features.title: Goals and Notes
features.description: Goals and Notes let you keep persistent observations about each learner. Record learning goals, challenges, breakthroughs, behavioral notes, or anything else important. These notes help provide continuity and personalized guidance across sessions.
features.howToUse: Click the 'Goals' button to open the goals clipboard. Type your notes and observations. They're saved automatically and persist across sessions. I can reference these notes to give better advice tailored to each learner's needs.
